name: Tressette
summary: Italian 40-card trick-taking game for 2 or 4 in partnerships where Aces, 3s, 2s and face cards score.
rules_text: Play with 40 Italian cards ranked 3, 2, Ace, King, Knight, Knave, 7-4. For 2 players deal 10 each and stack 20 face-down; for 4 deal 10 each in two partnerships opposite. Trick-taking: lead any card, others must follow suit if able. Highest of led suit wins trick. In 2-player version, winner draws first from stock then other, showing drawn card. Scoring per deck: Ace 1 point, King, Knight, Knave, 3, 2 each 1/3 point. Integer points count, leftover thirds go to last-trick winner, so 11 2/3 total plus 1 for last trick? Base described as 11 2/3. Play multiple deals summing points until a side reaches 21 points.
